page0.text:
There's a slithering sound.
It's hard to determine whether the sound is a cry, something being dragged, or something festering.
The sound represented everything.
Here, there are only rotting things.
The stone walls are as brittle as a decaying tree.
The air smells sweet like honey.
The creatures crawling on the ground are decomposing like ripe fruit, and even the time that passes in this space is rotten, meaningless.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page0:1

page1.text:
Everything here is worn out.
The darkness is a graveyard for things that were never mourned on earth, the end of vindictive bloodlines.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page1:1

page2.text: "It appears all seven have been selected."
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page2:1

page3.text:
The largest gangrenous mass wriggles at the center of darkness.
The sound of insects taints the air, along with a rancid, unpleasant stench.
The master of this basement is rotten and decayed, yet alive, and it is surrounded by otherworldly worms.
The insects that crawl up from the feet suck on its ankles, and once their suckers reach their host's flesh and bone, they continue to slowly burrow in to reach nerves.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page3:1

page4.text:
There are hundreds...nay, more than two hundred wriggling bugs.
Any creature unlucky enough to be thrown onto this writhing carpet would die in moments.
The insects would burrow in and devour its insides, leaving its flesh and bones intact, but taking it over.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page4:1

page5.text: "It's not enough. These bugs will need to be replaced soon."
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page5:1

page6.text:
Yet, its body does not break down.
Rather, whenever the insects invade its body through the ankle, its body takes one step closer to completion.
It is not being devoured by the insects.
The massive insects that live in the basement are the ones being consumed, existing solely to be eaten by it.
There should be enough here to last a hundred years.
That guarantees it at least that much time as it consumes these insects to live.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page6:1

page7.text: "Not enough time. This battle may not be the final one. I must observe in silence if the conditions are not optimal this time."
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page7:1

page8.text:
It twists its mouth in disapproval.
The situation is in no way optimal.
The battle is about to start once again, less than ten years after the last.
The priest who is tasked with overseeing this ritual possesses two Servants, and the Servant rooted in Ryudou Temple has in turn summoned their own Servant.
These conditions are not promising.
A complete Grail simply will not be forged from such an unstable battle.
The gates may open, but its contents will not be reachable.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page8:1

page9.text: "Then I shall confine myself to simply observing this one. Unfortunately, my pawns are at the optimal state right now."
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page9:1

page10.text:
The conditions to fight over the Holy Grail are abysmal.
However, the thing that was painstakingly created is in its ideal form.
If released, it would surely reach it.
As long as the proper steps are taken, the Holy Grail should be attainable.
After all, contents of the Holy Grail have been implanted inside them.
For ten years, fragments of the Holy Grail have spread into and throughout their nerves.
It is only natural for things originating from the same source be attracted to one another.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page10:1

page11.text: "Hmph. There may be a next time for me, but that thing isn't likely to last long. I may have I received it as a placental vessel initially, but I never expected it to be as good as it turned out."
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page11:1

page12.text:
The thing was an experiment, but now it has perfectly adapted to its purpose.
It was supposed to be disposed of, but it ought to be used if it proves useful.
In either case, the plan is to dispose of it anyway.
The thing is bound to be discarded, whether it loses in battle, is destroyed, or disabled.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page12:1

page13.text:
"Which raises one issue:
How will I motivate it to do its job?"
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page13:1

page14.text:
For some reason, the compatible masterpiece refuses to fight.
One approach would be taking over its mind, but it has put up a solid mental defense.
Well, that is why I wanted a vessel that possesses strong Magic Circuits.
It is only logical for something talented to be hardy in the face of poison trying to invade it.
Then, shall the obedient doll or the outstanding pupil be chosen?
If the latter, brainwashing would be out of the question.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page14:1

page15.text: "Just once...as long as there is a small opening, it will surely seek the Holy Grail on its own. But what to do..."
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page15:1

page16.text:
Creating that small opening is the difficult part.
That thing is not so weak as to be broken by coercion.
If it could break easily, it would have broken eleven years ago.
It has erected quite the fortress to defend itself, but it simply has no blade with which to fight back.
If it is to break, it must be from within.
Its futile emotions should be the key to transforming it.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page16:1

page17.text: "So you've come. Then it is time to create an opening."
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page17:1

page18.text:
Descending footsteps echo in the darkness.
The person walks in towards the center of the decaying insects.
The thing asks a predictable question:
Do all Masters have to be killed?
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page18:1

page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page19:1

page20.text:
Of course, there is no need to answer.
All Masters must die.
All Servants must be seized.
That is the ethos writhing within this basement.
But that thought is pushed aside.
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page20:1

page21.text: "If that is how you feel, then I have no choice. We shall resolve ourselves to simply observe once again."
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page21:1

page22.text:
It utters.
It emits a sigh of relief, and the mood softens.
After the thing indicates that it has no intention to fight by gently smiling...
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page22:1

page23.text: "But that will lead to a rather unfortunate outcome. Of all the vessels created this time, the Tohsaka girl has turned out to be quite formidable. If there is to be a winner, it will likely be her."
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page23:1

page24.text:
It murmurs in a disappointed tone.
"..."
The air feels slack once again.
Faint disappointment flickers like an ember in the basement.
The thing that has resisted fighting this entire time suddenly shows signs of reconsidering after hearing its single statement.
The thing is wavering.
A slight crack.
The thing does not even notice, but now a slight, unintended opening cracks their defenses.
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page24:1

page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-12:page25:1
